pages.text: The $(thing)Quern$() grinds grain into flour, oilseeds into oil and limestone into lime. It stays in the crafting grid and wears out slowly.
The $(thing)Kitchen Knife$() cuts dough into pasta, potatoes into fries and flax into fibre. Make it from flint or iron.
The $(thing)Surveyor's Chain$() stakes out field plots of any shape and measures them in acres. See Surveying Plots.
